source.caveat: PyPI attestations bind the official sdist and wheel to the publisher commit; they do not attest the custom portable tar.zst built for this portfolio.

tar_members.manifest_encoding: base64(zlib(UTF-8 JSON)); decode base64 then zlib decompress

safety_evidence.interpretation: The original archive and SHA256SUMS were fetched again as raw bytes and independently re-hashed. zstd -t passed; every TAR member was preflighted for path/type safety and every regular payload hashed; extraction was run as UID/GID 65534; all 315 archive members matched the extracted filesystem. The archive omits an explicit tools/ directory entry, so tar creates one implicit parent; the final comparator permits only that implied directory. Raw member manifest, extraction receipt and replay log are committed in this PR.
safety_evidence.qualification_boundary: T2 PASS_SCOPED covers archive integrity, member path/type preflight and non-root extraction only. It does not prove original package runtime execution (T3), current Runner integration (T4), business semantics (T5) or maintenance (T6).

current_main_compatibility.runner_contract: tool_meta unsets TOOL_ID, sources tools/<id>/meta.sh, then requires TOOL_ID == <id>, TOOL_VERSION and TOOL_KIND. Historical TOOL_TOOL_ID is explicitly documented as invalid.
current_main_compatibility.meta_generator_contract: make_meta.py writes TOOL_ID, TOOL_VERSION, TOOL_KIND; it does not emit TOOL_TOOL_ID.
current_main_compatibility.t4_blocker: Original archive meta.sh contains TOOL_TOOL_ID only. Current main Runner rejects this metadata. Rebuild with current main builder/metadata generator; do not silently alias or patch the old archive.

execution_environment.prior_wheelhouse_result: WHL_OFFLINE_SCOPED_PASS; historical alternate route, not repeated and not original portable Runner proof

qualification.T0: PASS_SCOPED_UPSTREAM_VERSION_LICENSE_AND_PYPI_PROVENANCE; custom portable archive SHA/size independently verified but not covered by PyPI attestation

findings.p1: Original package meta.sh exports TOOL_TOOL_ID rather than TOOL_ID, so current main Runner rejects it. Rebuild with current main builder and canonical metadata before T4.

p2_resolution.P2-01: RESOLVED_IN_RECORD: added the explicit AePPL MIT, aesara-devs MIT, and historical Academic Free License notices, while retaining Apache-2.0 as the project license expression and leaving unspecified AFL version unresolved.
p2_resolution.P2-02: RESOLVED_BY_INDEPENDENT_REPLAY: raw zstd integrity result, complete 315-member path/type/size manifest, non-root extraction receipt and replay log are now committed with hashes; T2 remains scoped to archive safety/extraction only.

replay_notes: The first post-extraction tree comparator flagged the implicit tools/ parent directory because the archive contains tools/pymc/... entries but no explicit tools/ directory member. The comparator was narrowed to allow only parent directories implied by archive member paths; final result matched all 315 archive members plus this single implicit parent.
The compact member manifest is stored as base64(zlib(JSON)); its uncompressed SHA256 and compressed SHA256 are recorded above so the exact member list can be reconstructed and verified.
